summary: A Java library for other JVM code, built with Maven as a module with tested Javadoc examples, an API check and Maven Central-ready jars.
description: Write a reusable Java library whose public API is one exported package in a JPMS module. Every public member has Javadoc whose examples run as tests, failures are records callers can switch over, and NullAway checks nullness at compile time. A separate consumer project builds against the installed jar on the module path, japicmp fails the build on a change that breaks callers, and the build makes the sources and Javadoc jars Maven Central requires. The shipped slug parser is the example to replace with your own API; publishing to Maven Central stays a person's step.
seoDescription: A Java library recipe for Maven Central: a JPMS module, Javadoc with tested examples, NullAway, a consumer project and japicmp compatibility checks.

projectExamples.title: Parser for a company file format
projectExamples.description: Replace the slug type with a parser that returns typed values and a record per kind of failure, with generated-input tests for every rule. The format's rules are custom work.

projectExamples.title: Shared domain types for several JVM services
projectExamples.description: Publish value types and validation that several Java services depend on, with the API check guarding each release. Publishing needs the team's own Maven Central account.

plain.whatItIs: A starter for reusable Java code that other Java programs add as a dependency, ready to publish on Maven Central, the main Java package registry.
goodAt: Sharing tested code between Java projects
Documentation whose examples are checked on every build
Catching changes that would break the code calling it
notGoodAt: A program people run themselves; choose the Java command-line or API stack.
Android or Kotlin-first projects, which usually build with Gradle.
